title: Your training together. More ways to connect.
summary: Find sessions, exercises and cardio together in Training. Connect through mutual friendships and workout conversations, keep moving while saves finish, and see saved training changes across devices. Settings, profiles and daily check-ins are easier to use.
changes: Training combines Sessions, Exercises and Cardio. Sessions keeps the existing calendar, day details, machine filters and workout cards, with the latest three weeks shown first and Show more for older workouts. The initial three-week window respects your week-start preference, and links can still open older sessions directly.

Exercises opens on a searchable list with muscle-group filters, Recent first, A-Z and Most improved sorting, and eight-week estimated 1RM trends. Tap a lift for its focused chart, personal bests and sessions, with an exercise header and back arrow replacing the Training header and tabs. Session rows open the completed sets before Open workout, and returning to Exercises keeps your search, filter, sort, scroll, metric and range.

Follows are now friendships. Send a friend request, and once it is accepted you both see each other’s shared training. Requests always need accepting, even for public profiles. Existing follows in either direction became friendships, and waiting follow requests became friend requests.

Social has its own bottom tab. Friends shows each friend once with their latest session, a seven-day activity strip and a reaction button. Find holds friend requests, people search, requests you sent and blocked members. Remove or block a friend from their profile, and Social stays highlighted while you view it. Home keeps its compact friends card.

Open the combined reactions and comments button on a shared workout to read its inline thread. Add an optional workout reaction with a comment, reply with a tappable @name, and react to comments. Comments and replies allow up to 280 characters. Reply and comment-reaction notices appear in the notification bell. Authors can edit or delete their comments; workout owners can moderate them. Existing sharing, friendship and block rules still apply. Removed the redundant Find friends header link from Social; use the Find tab.

Finish a workout or save an old session and keep navigating while the save completes. Routine notices and completion PRs no longer lock the page; failed saves retain your entries for retry and respect a screen you have moved to.

Saved workouts, bodyweight, goals and cardio refresh automatically across signed-in devices. The visible app checks every five seconds and when you return or reconnect, refreshes changed data quietly, and preserves active workouts, unsaved edits and filters. In-progress workouts stay on the device where you are logging.

Settings now opens with six clear sections: Training, Appearance, Notifications, Account & privacy, Data & connections, and Help & about. Search opens the matching section and control, including profile editing. All settings stays at the top of each section and returns to the overview. Browse cards omit preference summaries and the extra search hint. Switching sections keeps unfinished forms intact. Training groups units, goals, rest timers, workout types and bodyweight chart defaults; longer editors stay folded until needed. Export remains available for every import format.

Your profile now uses the same training layout as other members, with your calendar, training totals and workouts. Edit your name and photo here. Sharing, account ID, password, sign-out and account deletion are now in Settings. Private profiles can preview their own page without enabling sharing, without a private-profile reminder in the header.

Home offers three independently addable sections: Body weight check-in, Body fat check-in and Combined check-in. Add, hide, resize and arrange them through Edit Home layout. The old card becomes Combined in its existing position. Weight needs no body-fat value; body-fat entries still require today’s weight.

Home’s Friends card is now Recent Friends Activity. Tap +N more to show a loading spinner and add three friends inline. Expanded activity stays visible during refreshes, and the count includes only friends with sessions available.

Remove an individual rest by choosing 0:00 (no rest) or swiping left on its row. Undo restores it; removed rests remain removed when editing, saving or reopening the workout. Rest choices include 0:30. Show rest times in Settings hides the rows independently of the automatic rest timer.

Time trained switches between All time and Past year. Time trained and Profile sharing keep their explanations behind question-mark help buttons. The collapsed What you share arrow points down, independently of its parent section.

Notifications show 15 at a time, with page controls when there are more. Only notices on the displayed page are marked read, including comments and replies. The Manage friends link is gone; manage friends from Social.

Notifications and Profile now sit beside Settings in the same order on Home, Training, Social and Body. Removed the duplicate blue plus buttons from Training and Body headers; use Start for workouts and Log weigh-in for bodyweight entries.
Progress changes are green for increases, red for decreases, and neutral when unchanged across estimated 1RM, top set and volume.
Quick-start circles are now 52 px across, up from 44 px, with larger icons to make each option easier to see and tap.
Swipe down from the muscle details handle or header to close the sheet. You can also pull down on its content when the list is at the top; short pulls return to place and scrolling still works.
Removed the redundant Contributing exercises heading and count from muscle details. Done, Escape and tapping outside still close the sheet.
Past-workout exercise cards have more space between them in the view-only workout browser.

highlights.title: Your training, together
highlights.description: Sessions keeps the calendar and saved workouts. Exercises opens familiar progress tools, and Cardio stays within reach. Switch tabs and return to the view you were using.

image.alt: Training Sessions retains the calendar above the latest three weeks of workouts.

highlights.title: Your lifts, a clearer view
highlights.description: Search or filter the exercise list and compare eight-week trends. Open a lift for charts, personal bests and a session set sheet, then return with your list position and choices intact.

image.alt: Exercises opens on a full searchable list with muscle filters, recent or improvement sorting, eight-week trend lines and synthetic training data.

highlights.title: Focus on one lift
highlights.description: Open a lift with its name and back arrow in the top header. Switch chart metrics and date ranges, inspect personal bests, and view completed session sets. Back returns to the exercise list without losing your place.

image.alt: Barbell Bench Press with its own top header and back arrow above progress charts and personal bests, using synthetic workouts.

highlights.title: Friends, not followers
highlights.description: Send one friend request; once it is accepted you both see each other. Friends lists everyone once with their latest session and week. Find holds requests and people search.

image.alt: Social Friends tab listing synthetic friends once each, with a seven-day activity strip, latest session and reaction button.

highlights.title: Talk beside the workout
highlights.description: Open the combined reactions and comments button for an inline conversation. Add up to 280 characters, reply with tappable @names, and react to comments. Replies and reactions appear in Notifications; existing sharing and block rules still apply.

image.alt: An inline workout conversation with nested replies, tappable mentions, comment reactions and the combined activity button, using synthetic accounts.

highlights.title: Keep moving while saves finish
highlights.description: Finish a workout or save an old session, then keep browsing. Saving indicators, completion PRs and routine notices leave navigation and scrolling available. Failed saves keep your entries for retry.

image.alt: Finish a synthetic workout, navigate during its save, then open Body while the completion PR notice remains visible.

highlights.title: Your training stays in sync
highlights.description: Saved training changes from your other devices appear automatically. The visible app checks every five seconds and when you return or reconnect, while keeping your active workout and unsaved entries.

image.alt: A workout saved in a separate signed-in sample session appears on the desktop without reloading the page.

highlights.title: Settings, with a place for everything
highlights.description: Browse six focused sections with streamlined cards and an All settings return button at the top. Search opens the right panel and control; unfinished edits stay with you as you move between sections. Training defaults, appearance, alerts, account privacy and data tools each have a clear home.

image.alt: The streamlined Settings overview with six focused categories and search, using a synthetic sample account.

highlights.title: Your profile, focused on training
highlights.description: View your calendar, training totals and workouts in the same layout as your friends. Edit your name and photo here; manage privacy, your account and security in Settings. Your own page stays available when your profile is private.

image.alt: An isolated sample member's own profile with name and photo editing, workout totals and the consistency calendar, while their profile remains private.

highlights.title: Your time trained, over time
highlights.description: Switch between All time and Past year on your own and shared profiles. Past year counts training dated from the same day last year.

image.alt: Past year selected on a synthetic training profile, showing workout, cardio and combined time totals.

highlights.title: Your check-ins, arranged your way
highlights.description: Body weight, Body fat and Combined check-ins are separate Home sections. Use Edit Home layout to add, hide, resize and arrange each one. Body-fat entries still require today’s weight.

image.alt: Home with separate Combined, Body weight and Body fat check-in sections and synthetic saved measurements.

highlights.title: More recent activity, right on Home
highlights.description: Recent Friends Activity adds three friends when you tap +N more. A spinner shows loading, and refreshes keep the expanded list. The remaining count includes only friends with sessions.

image.alt: Recent Friends Activity shows a loading spinner, expands from five to eight synthetic friends and updates the remaining count.

highlights.title: Remove a rest, keep the set
highlights.description: Choose 0:00 (no rest) or swipe left on a rest row. Undo restores it. Removed rests stay removed when editing, saving or reopening; edit the set to add one back. Show rest times in Settings hides rows independently of the countdown.

image.alt: An isolated sample workout removes a rest with zero time, restores it with Undo, then removes it with a left swipe while retaining both sets.

highlights.title: Your account, on every tab
highlights.description: Open Notifications or Profile beside Settings on Home, Training, Social and Body. Matching buttons keep the same order and wrap neatly on smaller screens.

image.alt: Body with matching Notifications, Profile and Settings buttons at the top right and no duplicate header plus, using synthetic account data.

highlights.title: Larger quick-start circles
highlights.description: The bottom quick-start menu has slightly larger circles and icons for Cardio, Up next and Empty.

image.alt: Quick-start menu with larger Cardio, Up next and Empty circles.

highlights.title: Pull down to close muscle details
highlights.description: The sheet follows your finger. Short pulls return to place, and a deliberate downward swipe closes it. Exercise details sit directly below the goal.

image.alt: A short downward pull returns muscle details to place; a longer pull dismisses the sheet, with exercises listed without a redundant heading.
